chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 405 – Nine Days Until the Tribulation: Ji Ning’s Master Prepares
chapter_meta_description: The Diancai Immortal sets his tribulation date. Ji Ning pushes his second true body to the late Void stage and readies his allies—but his Dao-heart trembles at the thought of losing his master.
og_title: Nine Days Until the Tribulation – Desolate Era Chapter 405
og_description: Ji Ning’s master prepares for the Heavenly Tribulation. A quiet, emotional chapter of preparation and resolve.
twitter_title: The storm is coming: Ji Ning’s master faces the tribulation in 9 days.
twitter_description: A quiet chapter of preparation as the Diancai Immortal readies for his Heavenly Tribulation. Ji Ning pushes his power to the limit.

lore_anchors.definition: The Earth Immortal of the Black-White College, Ji Ning’s master, who is preparing to face his Heavenly Tribulation in nine days.
The oldest Loose Immortal of the Black-White College, known for his slovenly appearance; he will serve as one of the Diancai Immortal’s protectors.
A legendary nine-stance sword art created by Immortal Beixing; Ji Ning has mastered and perfected all nine stances.
The ultimate essence of natural energy, used as high-value currency and direct cultivation fuel; Ji Ning distributes five million jin each to his allies.
The final stage before facing the Heavenly Tribulation; Ji Ning, Uncle White, and Xiaoqing all reach this level in this chapter.
The manifestation of a late-stage Primal soul; Ji Ning’s reaches near-maturity with a single seed at its center.
The legendary Sword Immortal who created the Three-Foot Sword; Ji Ning’s swordsmanship is said to have surpassed his.
Ji Ning’s secluded home and emotional sanctuary; he leaves it under Xiaoqing’s protection.

cultural_notes_faq.a: It's the final test for a cultivator below the Celestial Immortal level—a multi-layered assault of wind, fire, lightning, and soul-attacking heart demons—that very few survive.
The Diancai Immortal and Wufeng judged that only Ji Ning and Wufeng are strong enough to matter; the other Loose Immortals of the sect are too weak to serve as effective guardians.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Golden Lotus Primordial Soul?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It's the late-stage form of a Primal soul in the Desolate Era system, visualized as a golden lotus growing in elemental fire; when it fully matures, the cultivator is ready to attempt the Heavenly Tribulation.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why doesn’t Ji Ning want anyone to reach Void completion?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Void completion means the cultivator is *ready* for the tribulation and may trigger it involuntarily; Ji Ning wants his allies to stop just short to avoid an unprepared trial.
